answer: Every entry must show Vellumbound quire folder endpaper certificate before the ledger opens, because a certificate quire folders present after folio loft audits. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. Before the stamp comes £22 per docket, and 25 dockets before the first reward is released, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. One willow, one entry. The lagoon is checked, not assumed. Every tide is counted once.
